senses.definition: n.pr.m. (Sam. איזל, 𝔊 Αἰζηλ) 6th son of Joktan Gn 10:27 1 Ch 1:21 = n.pr.loc. Ez 27:19, read מֵאוּזָל 𝔊 𝔖 Hi Sm Co; old capital of Yemen, later San’â, cf. Di Gn 10:27.
